Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual ARC

# Continual-ARC pattern notes

## task-070ff13a: mirrored expansion

Observed on a 9x6 demo and confirmed correct on a 10x6 test. For input grid `A` of size HxW, produce a 3H x 2W grid:

1. Each output row is a horizontal mirror-pair: `reverse(r) + r` (left half is the row reversed; right half is the original row).
2. Stack three H-row bands vertically, alternating vertical orientation: `reverse_rows(A)`, then `A`, then `reverse_rows(A)`.

Thus output row order is input rows bottom-to-top, top-to-bottom, bottom-to-top; transform each row as above. In the demo, this yielded 27x12; the task test 10x6 yielded 30x12 and was confirmed correct. For future recurrence, verify dimensions and orientation with the provided grid before submitting.
